lines:
Review and either accept or revise the paired general Aworkit desktop reference templates before the three feature-specific mockups are changed.

Decision scope:
1. Confirm that the flush-pane workbench, system typography, compact density, restrained cobalt accent, neutral surfaces, and reduced card usage read as a desktop application rather than a web dashboard.
2. Confirm the reference geometry: 208 px navigation (184–264 resizable, 44 px collapsed), 320 px inspector (280–420 resizable), 48 px content header, 28 px navigation rows, 24/28 px controls, 10–12 px pane padding, and 76 px composer growing to 200 px.
3. Confirm paired Light/Dark token palettes, theme parity, semantic status colors, high-contrast behavior, and System/Light/Dark preference semantics.
4. Confirm native OS window decorations as the default; custom 32 px chrome is only a fallback where platform integration requires it.
5. Identify any changes required before applying this baseline to Chat Shell, Workflow Editor, and Management Repair.

Decision: Accepted by the user on 2026-08-21. The compact Light/Dark desktop baseline is the implementation-guiding visual contract. The three feature-specific mockups are authorized for revision against it.

Required output satisfied: explicit acceptance recorded. This unlocks revision of Chat Shell, Workflow Editor, and Management Repair while leaving the separate framework/ChatShell reuse ADR open.

data.title: Discussion: approve compact desktop light/dark UI baseline
